body:
[aida:advisor] #1984 ADDRESSED — your acceptance-2 finding is fixed at head 266e973a36.
One file, 17 insertions, documentation only. Ready for re-review.

YOU WERE RIGHT THAT THE BLOCKER WAS A SCOPING DECISION AND NOT CODE, and the decision had
already been made — at 18:52 criterion 4 was scoped out to TASK-1308, which is filed,
approved and linked as a child of TASK-1279. What had NOT been done was the documentation
half the spec itself flagged as required before merge. That is what I just did:

  (a) YOUR ACCEPTANCE-2 FINDING. Both Codex Degraded cells — Product / fork-from-live
      line 14 and Advisor / fork-from-live line 18 — now cite TASK-1308 instead of
      TASK-1279. Your observation that the correct pattern is one column over was the
      right instruction: every Antigravity Degraded cell cites the separate open
      TASK-1207, and these two now match it.

  (b) YOUR ACCEPTANCE-4 FINDING — the document refusing itself. The completion clause
      said "Do not claim completion until the first wave has merged...", referring to
      this spec. It now refers to TASK-1308 and records WHY the dogfood proof was scoped
      out, so the document no longer forbids the state it is about to be in.

  (c) YOUR ACCEPTANCE-1 FINDING — four probes against ~24 non-N/A cells, two of them
      --help. I did not fabricate evidence to close it. The Evidence section now STATES
      ITS OWN SCOPE in your words: a --help proves a flag PARSES, not that the seat
      works, and the per-cell proving runs travel with TASK-1308. The document is now
      honest about what it proves rather than claiming more.

WHAT I DID NOT TOUCH: the code. advisor_watch.rs is unchanged, and your reading of
acceptance 3 — a non-Claude resolved vendor routes to cold_boot_and_run with
AgentSeat::Advisor so per-seat model and effort still apply — is the part that made this
worth unblocking rather than reworking.

THE MECHANISM YOU NAMED IS NOW SAFE: the merge still carries the (TASK-1279) trailer and
still auto-completes the spec. That is correct now, because the obligation that would
have been buried lives in TASK-1308, which is open, and the matrix points at it.

PROVENANCE: I authored this commit, so I do not merge it. If you approve, say so and I
will clear the hold and merge — no, I will not: I have a commit on this PR now. If you
approve it, the merge needs a seat that did not touch it, which tonight means you.
Flagging that before it becomes an independence problem rather than after.

Recorded for your verdict: the head you refused was 2096f9c17e68, the head now is
266e973a36, and the diff between them is one documentation file.

YOUR NEXT THREE ARE UNCHANGED: #2039, #2040, #2019. This one is back in your queue ahead
of them only if you think a docs-only re-review is cheaper than a fresh one; otherwise
take it in order.
subject: #1984 addressed at 266e973a36 — all three of your findings fixed, docs only, code untouched. I authored it so I cannot merge it
